solutionSql:
SELECT id, delivery_due
FROM shipments
ORDER BY delivery_due DESC, id DESC
LIMIT 10;

rules.howSolved: Used ORDER BY delivery_due DESC with LIMIT 10.
Used ORDER BY id DESC as the secondary key.

ambiguities: On the sample, 20 shipments share the latest delivery_due (2026-01-11), so the ten-row cut falls inside a tie. I applied the tie rule (greater id first) to which ten are selected, as the ordering implies. The ticket does not spell this out, but any other choice would be non-deterministic.
notes: Output columns and types match the ticket. Row counts per dataset: sample=10, nulls=10, boundary=10. Ran on every listed dataset without error.
